notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Howdy Friends!

We've just pushed a new update that fixes some bugs and makes some tweaks to a few cards.

Please take a look at the changelog below:

CARDS:

Silence!
Time at min. level reduced from 4 to 3
Time at max. level reduced from 7 to 4,5

Sticky Bomb
Damage range reduced from 4m to 2m

Invisible Buff
Cost decreased from 3 to 2

Reroll Changes
No longer has levels and no longer gives extra card draws. Changed rarity to Legendary.
Cost decreased from 3 to 2

Mirror Card
Cost decreased from 2 to 1

Bouncy Wall
Bullets are now reflected towards the shooter.
HP at min. level reduced from 600 to 200
HP at max. level reduced from 900 to 300

Card Thief
Temporal cards that originally affected other players such as Self Destruct or Reverse Titan will now induce the correct effect onto their original owner when stolen from them (detonate your opponents with their own self-destruct device, hehe) ːsteamhappyː

Laser Fence:
Using this card will now automatically place a fence pole and add the remaining poles into the player's hand.

Present:
Present now doesn't give Grenade Lover + Garbage Day

BUG FIXES:


 Dale Donovan no longer deals critical explosion damage

 Jumping into lava with the Ice Block effect will now destroy it

 Players with discovered but unearned propagating cards such as 404 or Present can now unlock them properly


- Brainwash Gang and Raw Fury

notes.title: SPRING CLEANING UPDATE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/ccca7f0268d713b965604bae42b2e19b5507e71b.png

Heya, friendmigos! 

We mentioned in last Friday's Bulletin that we had a new update for y'all, and it's HERE! 

It's mostly a bunch of stuff to make the game flow better, but we got a couple other little cool things thrown in.

So here's the stuff that's got all changearoo'd:

You can now change characters or decks between matches!

Ever just think you could've won if you just had that one card in that one deck that you just happened to not pick? Well now you don't need to go back to the HUB and change up everything before jumping back into the action! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/c18fb1aa5151cba3bf440592c28fef4a8972b004.png

You can now have 8 saved deck slots!

Go ahead and get into deckbuilding something NUTS for us. You've got the space for it now, no excuses! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/7accc1db0dd7873a6f49fcd7f99447655847f3c3.png

PalPrizes will no longer steal your organs!

Also we're streamlining and reducing the use of PalPrizes so you get a chance for a skin every day alongside maybe getting a keychain, profile pic, or card back. 

All hail Jakob, the Hero!

We've built a state in the lobby in honor of Jakob, the only player that has won 10,000 matches. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/786b19e1eb7ba0eabb02b2e4eb8de6b85a96cc75.png

Cardbacks, Cardbacks, Cardbacks!

Y'all got NEW CARDBACKS to enjoy! Based off of the tournaments hosted by KTqtpi (the carpet one!), and two other tournaments hosted in our Community Discord server that you should absolutely join and why aren't you there right now? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849910/b40017372f03b0e89b4066e61243af8a35a8ef55.png

And I'm OUTIE. Hope y'all have a great time killin' each other and enjoy the new ~*~flow~*~ ! 

- The Not-Mayor of Friendtown

Now, let's dive into an update that includes several bug fixes. Please have a look at the details below.


Changelog

Changes:

 Explosions revisited: to ensure consistency, explosion damage now is dealt in segments of its radius (This means max damage on the first third of its radius, mid damage on the second, minimum damage on the final third).

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello, Friends!

Remember when we mentioned on Monday that we're working on the matchmaking system? Well, we've got some news to share! This is our first attempt to tackle some of the issues players have been reporting, and we'll keep fine-tuning the matchmaking to make it the absolute best it can be.

Changelog
Content & Features


Matchmaking
 Improved level-based matchmaking: Improved chances of finding matches with players on at a similar level as you & fixed an issue when a party is created and enters the 2v2 queue


UI Updates
 Added controller binding to the "Invite Friend" shortcut
 Improved UI navigation with controller
 Rich text is disabled in nickname tags so that players can't change colors/format


Bug Fixes

 Fixed: Out of bounds & occlusion issues in Subway Station
 Fixed: The first voted map is always the picked map for the rematch
 Fixed: Friends & "Recently played with" widgets in the Friends menu get mixed up & unsorted after a few seconds
 Fixed: "There's nothing to lose at this point" can't be obtained
 Fixed: The Self-Destruct card explosion didn’t do any damage, now it does! 
 Fixed: Bots on Rooftop stay defensive
 Fixed: There was a bug where all explosive quests didn’t work as intended
 Fixed: Removed the movie playing on the Theatre's screen to avoid random crashes


Issues with matchmaking in Australian regions

Additionally, we've received numerous reports about high ping issues & incorrect 'best regions' from users based in Australia. We've been going through this issue with our multiplayer server provider and found out that this issue is, for now, exclusive to all players who have internet provided by the company Optus, or any ISP that relays on the Optus network.

If that's your case, we're terribly sorry, but there's not much we can do on our side. We can tell you about some workarounds some of you found, though!

1. Using Cloudflare WARP. You can access it here: https://1.1.1.1 (it looks shady but we promise it's not!). It's free, so give it a shot if you don't have access to a paid VPN service!

2. Using Optus Game Path. You can access it here: https://www.optus.com.au/broadband-nbn/gaming-internet-plans/game-path

3. Using any VPN service of your choosing. Since the issue is how the Optus network reroutes the connection to our Australia server, this should potentially fix the high ping, no matter the service you use.

Again, we're sorry about this, and we hope these solutions can help you enjoy Friends vs Friends with us ❤️

Until next time!

- Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
Howdy, Friends!

It feels like both an eternity and no time has passed since we went live on Tuesday with the game! HUGE thanks to the community for turning up and battling your buds (and soon-to-be besties). 

Our first major patch for Friends vs Friends is now live! We'd like to thank all of you for your support and feedback since launch, we hope you enjoy this latest update and the many more to come - we're just getting started.

Changelog
Content & Features
 - Level-based Matchmaking

 Matchmaking now properly takes level into account when searching for a match, which should result in much fairer games. Players who wish to disable this feature are able to. Please let us know if you run into any issues with this system!

 - Progression Revamp

 We've heard your feedback loud and clear, the progression feels too slow. In this patch, we're making a number of changes both to the frequency of rewards, speed of leveling, and introducing a new level cap. These changes should make for a much more satisfying experience. Some of you may see some immediate level-ups as a result of this change, surprise! :)

 - Report system

 You can now report players for suspicious activity on the match aftermath screen by pressing the "!" button in the right corner.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where players could fall outside the map without dying by using the Ice Block card
 Fixed a freeze when spamming the space bar while opening packs
 Fixed: a bug where the camera could temporarily become offset when receiving explosion damage


We're working on a meaty update for tomorrow, right here on Steam, so keep your eyes peeled as we release our first of a weekly series we like to call the "Buddy's Bulletin"! We'll cover game updates, and community submissions, and start building out the lore of Friends vs Friends that you've been requesting!

Thanks again and see you on the playing field!

- Brainwash Gang & Raw Fury
